headline: Aurus Gem Corporation submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results now on record
summary: Aurus Gem Corporation Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The company completed its mandatory compliance filing with the exchange. Routine corporate filings of this nature have minimal impact on retail trading volumes.
why_it_matters: No direct consequence for retail investors
